fun_facts: Malik Washington is from Lawrenceville, Georgia.
After playing at Northwestern, Malik Washington transferred to Virginia as a graduate student.
In 2023, Malik Washington caught 110 passes, breaking the single-season reception records at Virginia and in the ACC; his 1,426 receiving yards also set a Virginia single-season record.
Malik Washington had 10 games with 100 or more receiving yards in 2023, the most in the FBS that season.
In 2023, Malik Washington was a team captain and earned first-team All-ACC and second-team All-American honors.
